explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/794: the Frankl–Füredi construction shows that the K₄⁻-free (no 4 vertices spanning 3 edges) edge density is at least 2/7. The statement gives, for every ε > 0 and large n, a 3-uniform H on Fin n without 4 vertices spanning 3 edges and with ≥ (2/7 − ε)C(n,3) edges. Faithful.
